card.title: Quiet Win
card.lyrics:
[verse]
Nobody clapped when you got up today
Nobody saw the mountain in the way
[chorus]
But I saw it I saw it
The smallest bravest thing
You did it you did it
Let the quiet room sing
card.note: Density experiment: same lyrics, key, tempo and seed as quiet_win, with a thinner band. Testing whether arrangement density is what buries the vocal.

tags_sent: soft pop, sparse arrangement, solo piano, light brushed snare, tender, proud, clear female lead vocal
